source.note: The EBS CSI driver publishes NO Kubernetes compatibility matrix: its README says only that it 'is compatible with all Kubernetes versions supported by the Kubernetes project and/or Amazon EKS (including extended support versions)', so supportWindows is deliberately OMITTED and the hop is the opt-in CURRENCY hop (currencyHop=true) to latestKnownVersion, the newest CHANGELOG release at the pinned commit; every surface says it is NOT required by the Kubernetes upgrade. What the README does publish is a support POLICY — 'Support will be provided for the latest version and one prior version' — transcribed as supportedMinorsBehindLatest=1: an installed minor older than that gets a finding. The EKS managed add-on's per-Kubernetes compatibility lives only in `aws eks describe-addon-versions --addon-name aws-ebs-csi-driver` and is not transcribed. Rules: zero hand-written rules/upgradeNotes here; the notes are extracted mechanically into scripts/readiness-agent/kb/aws-ebs-csi-driver/notes-<minor>.md (extract-aws-ebs-csi-driver-notes.py, floor 1.17 = the first release with an Urgent Upgrade Notes section; Urgent / [ACTION REQUIRED] / deprecation sections kept whole, other bullets filtered by an upgrade vocabulary; the Dependencies sections dropped) and the rules live in src/main/resources/k8s-rules/aws-ebs-csi-driver/ (sourceId aws-ebs-csi-driver, hop-scoped: the driver's 1.x minors overlap Kubernetes minors by number). The pinned ref is a master COMMIT, not the v1.66.0 tag, because each release's CHANGELOG entry is written on master after the tag. The aws-ebs-csi-driver Helm chart's own CHANGELOG (chart versions 2.x, versioned separately) is NOT read: it only affects self-managed Helm installs. Detection: the ebs-plugin container image repository ends in /aws-ebs-csi-driver on EKS ECR (…/eks/aws-ebs-csi-driver), public.ecr.aws/ebs-csi-driver and registry.k8s.io/provider-aws; the version is that image's tag (v1.66.0, v1.54.0-a1compat → 1.54.0). The csi-* sidecars and livenessprobe are separate repositories and do not match.
